statement_summary: Annual risk assessment (SP 800-30) and targeted risk analyses
PCI DSS scope confirmed yearly; every SAQ answer backed by evidence
Service provider agreements, provider list, responsibility matrix, annual AOC or SOC 2 check
Sanctions for policy violations
Privacy and pricing claims reviewed before publication
Change control for checkout page, theme, tags, and apps
Payment page script inventory, authorization, integrity, and tamper detection
Unique accounts; no shared POS or storefront accounts
Least privilege; no script or app rights for contractors
MFA for all administrator and remote access
Same-day access removal at termination
Quarterly access and app reviews
System credentials stored securely and rotated every 90 days
On-demand, named, MFA vendor remote access
Network separation for IoT, POS back office, office, and guest Wi-Fi
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Keep logs 1 year; weekly review; same-day triage of payment page alerts
Acquirer notice within 24 hours of suspected compromise
Preserve evidence with chain of custody
Meet notification deadlines
Annual incident response training and test
Never store card numbers or sensitive authentication data
Encrypt Restricted data; no Restricted email attachments
Customer data used only for noticed purposes
Isolated immutable backups restore-tested quarterly
Receipt truncation checked after POS updates
Annual training; quarterly phishing exercises; PIN pad tamper training
PIN pad inspections at opening and weekly
No scripts, tags, or apps outside the change process
Approved AI tools only for customer data
